queries_run: Cencora export control OR entity list Medical Distribution 2026

findings.claim: Cencora FY2025 10-K 風險因素：公司可能因美國關稅或其他保護措施而面臨供應中斷、短缺或額外成本（含包裝、材料、設備），並點名既有芬太尼關稅、對等關稅、對印度／巴西產品的次級關稅，以及 Section 232 對藥品與原料的威脅性關稅；公司稱無法預測其實施或調整方式。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal 2025, we continued to experience increased costs, including for fuel, and it is possible that we could experience supply disruptions, shortages, or additional costs (including with respect to packaging, materials, and other equipment) resulting from U.S. tariffs or other protective measures.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明所購藥品受價格通膨／通縮及已威脅與已實施關稅影響；學名藥價格通縮加速會加重對經營結果的負面衝擊。
findings.excerpt: The pharmaceutical products that we purchase are also subject to price inflation and deflation, as well as the threatened and enacted tariffs described above.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明公司受美國出口管制與貿易制裁法規約束，違反可能導致罰款及喪失出口許可；未提及已發生的出口管制事件。
findings.excerpt: we are subject to the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (the “FCPA”), U.S. export control and trade sanction laws, and similar anti-corruption and international trade laws in certain foreign countries

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 Cencora 被列入 Entity List 或具體受 Section 232 藥品關稅費率影響的第三方來源；僅執行 2 次搜尋。
